svg.title: Chat — Recipient autoplay queue and receipts (sequence)

g.text: Chat — Recipient autoplay queue and receipts (sequence)
hold; UI shows "Tap to enable audio" banner
tap → unlock() (play silent clip, resume AudioContext)
message received and queued, autoplay held
next item preloaded on a second element)
next item (strict seq order, one at a time)
setRate(1.5) → applies to current item immediately
and to every following item (persisted in localStorage)
Two tabs or devices: only connections open on this channel are
candidates. The most recently focused one sends playback.claim and
plays; the others mark items delivered, stay silent and show
"▶ play here", which sends playback.claim from that tab.
